title: Red Lion Crimson Hard-coded Cryptographic Key Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Red Lion Crimson. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the CTextStreamMemory class. The class contains hard-coded secrets in clear text. An attacker can leverage this to decrypt user passwords.
